title: DISTRESS BEACON DETECTED
description: An anomalous narrow-beam emergency beacon is transmitting from the shadow of a deep gravitational well. Telemetry registers exotic isotopic radiation and encrypted telemetry packets.

options.label: Maintain Nominal Trajectory (Safe)
options.riskDescription: No risk to spacecraft. Continue on primary mission flight plan.
options.successReward: Spacecraft integrity and fuel margins fully preserved.
options.engineeringExplanation: Flight Director protocol prioritizes primary mission objectives over unknown opportunistic encounters.

options.label: Execute Gravitational Burn & Investigate (HIGH RISK)
options.riskDescription: Gravitational sheer stresses and unknown radiation field. 50% base success chance (modified by hull armor, shielding, avionics, and sensors). Fatal hull breach if maneuvers fail!
options.successReward: +350 Rare Science Data, +120 kg salvaged high-grade propellant, and legendary Kepler sector telemetry!
options.failurePenalty: CRITICAL HULL COLLAPSE: Instant mission loss and destruction of spacecraft.
options.engineeringExplanation: Diverting into an uncharted gravity well subjects the spaceframe to tidal gradient torque and intense relativistic particle fluxes.

title: Coronal Mass Ejection (Radiation Spike)
description: A high-energy proton storm ejected from a solar flare is sweeping across the spacecraft's orbital path. Subsystems risk latch-up and thermal overload.

options.label: Orient Shield Toward Sun & Enter Safe Mode
options.riskDescription: Shuts down scientific instruments for 72 hours. Minor telemetry blackout.
options.successReward: All electronic components protected. Minimal hull degradation (-5 HP).
options.engineeringExplanation: Using the spacecraft bus as a shadow shield protects sensitive semiconductors while halting science operations.

options.label: Ride the Storm & Maintain Active Sensor Collection
options.riskDescription: Collect unique magnetosphere solar wind data, but risk severe circuit degradation.
options.successReward: +85 Bonus Solar Science points gathered from active sensor recording.
options.failurePenalty: -35 Hull HP and 15% permanent solar panel degradation.
options.engineeringExplanation: High energy protons cause displacement damage in silicon solar arrays and bit-flips in unshielded registers.

title: Micrometeorite Swarm Penetration
description: Hypervelocity interplanetary dust grains have struck the service module exterior. Pressure sensors in the propellant manifold trigger an audible warning.

options.label: Isolate Fuel Manifold & Vent Affected Sector
options.riskDescription: Loses 45 kg of propellant, but stops further structural cascade.
options.successReward: Propellant line sealed safely. Hull stabilized at -15 HP.
options.failurePenalty: Additional 25 kg propellant vented before valve locks.
options.engineeringExplanation: Fast isolation valves prevent propellant tank depolymerization at the cost of the vented sector volume.

options.label: Inject Autonomous Sealant Gel & Fire RCS
options.riskDescription: Conserves fuel if successful, but requires quick avionics reaction.
options.successReward: Zero fuel lost! Whipple bumper composite self-heals.
options.failurePenalty: -30 HP hull breach and 80 kg propellant loss.
options.engineeringExplanation: Polymer sealant relies on ambient temperature gradients; if puncture is too wide, gel flashes into vacuum.

title: X-Band Downlink Gimbal Anomaly
description: The high-gain antenna azimuth tracking motor has seized at a 14-degree offset from Earth nadir, attenuating carrier signal strength.

options.label: Slew Entire Spacecraft Body to Align Antenna
options.riskDescription: Uses reaction wheels and 20 kg RCS hydrazine to point the entire frame toward Earth.
options.successReward: Full 100% telemetry link restored. No data lost.
options.failurePenalty: Consumes 40 kg extra fuel due to momentum desaturation.
options.engineeringExplanation: Body-pointing compensates for mechanically seized gimbals, transferring work from antenna motors to reaction thrusters.

options.label: Switch to Low-Gain Omni Antenna (Lossy)
options.riskDescription: No fuel expenditure, but downlink data throughput drops by 60%.
options.failurePenalty: High-volume imagery discarded due to downlink buffer saturation.
options.engineeringExplanation: Low-gain omni antennas have low EIRP gain and cannot sustain wideband transmission over interplanetary distances.

title: Unusual Subsurface Resonance Signal
description: Scientific instruments detect harmonic acoustic and electromagnetic oscillations resonating from deep beneath the crust.

options.label: Reconfigure Spectrometer & Run Long-Integration Scan
options.riskDescription: Draws 75 W extra power for 48 hours to boost signal-to-noise ratio.
options.failurePenalty: Temporary battery brownout forces 24-hr diagnostic reset.
options.engineeringExplanation: Long-exposure Fourier integration pulls periodic signals out of thermal noise, confirming hydrothermal venting.

options.label: Record Standard Raw Baseline & Continue
options.riskDescription: Standard telemetry mode with zero risk to power reserve.
options.engineeringExplanation: Maintains mission timeline margins without stressing electrical balance.
